description: Adapts a team program with AI for a member's level, goals, schedule or limits, as an unsaved draft. Use when the user wants a version of an existing program for someone, e.g. 3 days a week or injury-safe. Not for a plain copy (use duplicate_content) or a new program from scratch (use generate_program). Returns the draft's workouts with what was kept, swapped or added; save it with create_program.

age.description: Member's age, 16 to 99, e.g. 34. Omit if unknown.

fitness_levels.description: Member's fitness levels, first is primary, e.g. ["intermediate"]. Values: beginner, intermediate, advanced.

gender.description: Member's gender: male, female or other. Omit if unknown.

goal_ids.description: Member's goal IDs from list_team_goals. Omit for the original's goals.

guideline_id.description: Guideline ID from list_programming_guidelines (source=mine). Used with guideline_mode=explicit.

guideline_mode.description: Programming guideline to follow: auto = best match; none = no guideline; explicit = the one in guideline_id. Omit for the backend default.

id.description: ID of the team program to adapt. Get it from list_team_programs.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

training_days_per_week.description: How many days a week the member trains, 1 to 7.

user_guidance.description: Free-text context, up to 2000 characters: injuries, space, equipment, likes, e.g. "Knee pain, no jumping".

workout_sources.description: Where added or swapped workouts may come from: team = the team's workouts; template = the Hyperhuman template library. Omit for team only.

name: create_similar_program
title: Create a similar program
